findings.title: Prepay numeric string coercion in numeric-for and table.concat before strconv allocations
findings.proof: A 65539-byte numeric string reused 128 times returns keep under a finite 1048576-byte reservation limit. Numeric-for reserved589540 B but cumulative Go allocation delta9499248 B; table.concat reserved658163 B but allocated9525416 B. The strconv.ParseInt syntax-error copy and related numeric conversions execute before any ownership reservation. Neither execution returns memory refusal. This defeats the cumulative evaluation allocation promise; it does not establish live heap or OOM by itself.
findings.required: Cover every reachable variable-length numeric conversion with the shared allocation scope before entering strconv; add quota refusal regressions including pcall terminal semantics.
